notes.title: 🧀 Cheese Maze - Patch Notes v1.0.171
notes.notes:
Greetings, Cheese Hunters! 🐭
We've rolled out an exciting new update packed with improvements to make your maze-running experience smoother and more accessible than ever!

 
✨ New Features
🌍 Added Language Support:

Cheese Maze is now available in multiple new languages! We're making the game more accessible to players around the world. You can select your preferred language through Steam.

🐧 New Linux & Steam Deck Build:

Cheese Maze now runs natively on Linux and is fully compatible with the Steam Deck! Whether you're on the go or on your desktop, the hunt for cheese never stops. 


🔧 Engine & Performance
🚀 Upgraded to the Latest Engine Version:

We've updated the game to the latest version of the Unity engine to ensure better performance, stability, and compatibility across devices.  


🎨 UI Enhancements
🖥️ Updated User Interface:

The UI has been refreshed with cleaner visuals and improved usability. Menus, buttons, and HUD elements have been redesigned for a more polished and intuitive experience. 



Thank you for your continued support! Your feedback helps make Cheese Maze even better. Stay cheesy!

notes.title: Update v1.0.166
notes.notes:
Cheese Maze Update v1.0.166

Fixed initial sound volume loading and volume slider. It will now correctly save and load the volumes. The in-game timer display now shows correct times.
The level selection now always starts at the first page.

Thank you for playing Cheese Maze and giving Feedback!

notes.title: Update v1.0.165
notes.notes:

Thank you for playing Cheese Maze and giving Feedback!
